heard: I used to have to handle every message myself. When messages came at night or when I was busy, I couldn't keep up with the volume.
That's a digital responder in Turkey. The field team. Two people.
So at Zogreo, we ran a pilot.
Our AI leads each person through three Bible studies, answers their questions, and follows up.
Those who finish and obey in faith are handed to the team on the ground.
The result? The same team could serve 3.73 times as many people,
and they found disciple-making leaders at about the same rate.
One more thing. Many who answer these ads are hostile and responders take the abuse.
In the pilot, our AI took it instead and answered graciously.
In the responder's words, I don't have to deal with inappropriate or profane comments, and I get to spend more time on the people that are most interested.
Our AI doesn't replace the team. It multiplies them.
